shapeSummary: Single 80 mm diameter, 10 mm wide wheel with its axis along Z, centered at X=0 and Z=0, with the bottom of the tire at Y=0 (wheel center at Y=40). It has a 3 mm thick-walled tire ring (R37–40), a thin yellow rim ring, three straight bars forming six radial spokes (5 mm wide, 4 mm thick), and a 13 mm radius central hub. The hub has a 3 mm center bore and six 3 mm through holes: a pair at ±6.35 mm on X, and two pairs 19.1 mm apart at Y=±5.51 mm.
warnings: Dimensions are unverified, taken from product text and image estimates.
The hub bore is a plain 3 mm round hole; the D-shaft flat is omitted.
Spoke slots for M2 screws are omitted because they are not dimensioned.
Tire inner radius, rim width, spoke thickness and hub radius are estimated.
Mounting hole positions are estimated. The 12.7 mm pair is on the X axis and the 19.1 mm pairs are at Y=±5.51 mm.
Tire tread texture is omitted, and the tire and wheel are fused into one solid.
Only one wheel is modeled, although the product is sold as a pair.

tire = cq.Workplane('XY').circle(40).circle(37).extrude(5, both=True)

    body = body.union(spoke)

part = body.translate((0, 40, 0))
